newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu 7,025 to dlr on March 27 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu 7,025 to dlr on March 27 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Thursday it had calculated the exchange rate of the leu at 7,025 to the dollar for March 27.

The rate, which is not compulsory for book-keeping operations or inter-bank deals, would be used by the Finance Ministry, customs authorities, prosecutor's office and police as well as for statistical purposes.
The announced rate is based on prices quoted by commercial banks operating on Romania's foreign exchange market.
Wednesday's rate was 7,032 lei to the dollar.
